mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1% indicates monetary easing, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls below 1% but SPX shows negative 20-day returns more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates indicate economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but SPX returns remain positive, indicating no impact.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals reduced demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as corporate revenues decline.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth is negative but SPX returns are positive, indicating no demand impact.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 returns through increased economic activity.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows but SPX returns are negative, indicating no supply impact.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If HOUST exceeds 1.6 million but SPX returns are negative, indicating no demand impact.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings increase.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% but SPX returns are negative, indicating no growth impact.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate combined with high unemployment indicates a specific policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 returns through stimulus effects.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is low and UNRATE high but SPX returns are negative, indicating no policy impact.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production combined with low consumer spending indicates supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO is high and RSAFS growth is low but SPX returns are positive, indicating no imbalance impact.
